name: mega-menu
title: Mega menu
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Navigation bar whose triggers open a wide panel. A container under 768px stacks the same panel as an accordion.

meta.descriptionEs: Barra con un panel ancho por sección. En un contenedor estrecho se vuelve un acordeón.

examples.title: Mega menú
examples.description: Panel de tienda al pasar el cursor. En 320px se apila.

meta.usage:
<MegaMenu
  label="Store"
  items={items}
  openOn="hover"
  value={value}
  onValueChange={setValue}
  renderLink={({ href, className, children }) => <Link href={href} className={className}>{children}</Link>}
/>

api.name: items
api.description: A link, or a trigger with a panel: featured card, columns, and highlights.

api.name: openOn
api.description: Hover waits briefly before open and close. Click still toggles. Default hover.

api.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
api.description: Open panel id. Null is closed. Omit value for internal state.

api.name: renderLink
api.description: Render each href, for example with Next.js Link. The element must accept className, onClick, and children.

api.name: layout
api.description: auto uses the nav width and switches under 768px. wide and narrow force a layout.

api.name: openDelayMs / closeDelayMs / label / className
api.description: Hover delays, the nav landmark name, and the root class.

docs: Clean-room behavior inspired by a Design & Code With AV reel. No premium code, class names, colors, images, or Bootstrap Icons were copied. The host has no navigation-menu primitive, so this item is its own disclosure nav and does not replace site-header or dock-nav. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite badge or separator. The item ships no theme. Triggers are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Escape closes and returns focus. Arrow keys move across the bar. Under 768px the panel stacks in the flow. With reduced motion the panel fades without the vertical slide.
